# 2025 Zee Cine Awards

|channel = Zee Cinema
| last = 2024
| next = 2026
}}
The 23rd Zee Cine Awards ceremony, presented by Zee Entertainment Enterprises, honoured the best Hindi films of 2024. The event took place on 17 May 2025 in Mumbai, India, with the telecast airing on 7 June 2025 on Zee TV, Zee Cinema, and streaming on ZEE5.
The ceremony was hosted by Aparshakti Khurana and Vikrant Massey. Performances included Kartik Aaryan, Shraddha Kapoor, Kriti Sanon, Ananya Panday, Tamannaah Bhatia, Rashmika Mandanna, Jacqueline Fernandez, Tiger Shroff, Rasha Thadani, and others.
Films such as Stree 2,  Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3, Laapataa Ladies, Chandu Champion, and Sector 36 dominated the awards. Kartik Aaryan and Shraddha Kapoor won major acting awards in the Viewers' Choice categories, while Laapataa Ladies won Best Film.
